title: Card Concepts Lab
summary: 16 text-only concepts across 8 mechanics. Not playable. All numbers are provisional and require future combat balancing.
selection: A curated fit assessment, not an objective all-time ranking: favor meaningful choices, readable turns and bounded combinations in small decks against telegraphed attacks.
baseline: Level 0 reference: Ember Blade costs 1 for 6 damage; Crystal Ward costs 1 for 5 Block; Sundering Arc costs 2 for 13 damage; Winter Bastion costs 2 for 11 Block. Proposed cards cost energy, not Aether. Existing Block expiry, Armor, hand limits and encounter rules still apply unless stated.
boundaries: Review only: no registration in card definitions, side cards, rewards, shops, starters or saves.
No graphics. Every level is a text-only proposal.
Preserves Pitch/Aether, Retain, Suspend and Prismatic Counter.
No new creature board, land system, reaction stack or unlimited extra turns.

mechanics.name: Amplify
mechanics.rule: Pay the extra energy once when playing this card to receive its bonus.
mechanics.fit: Flexible spending competes with banking unused energy as Aether.
mechanics.risk: Power Boost modifies the base effect only, not the bonus.

mechanics.name: Cycle
mechanics.rule: Instead of playing, pay 1 energy, discard this card and draw 1. Only one Cycle per turn across all cards.
mechanics.fit: Situational cards can improve a poor hand without free card advantage.
mechanics.risk: No play, mastery, combo or Aether triggers. The cycled card cannot enter a reshuffle until the replacement draw finishes; draw nothing if no other card is available.

mechanics.name: Foresee
mechanics.rule: Look at up to the top 2 cards of your draw pile. Put any on the bottom and the others on top in your chosen order. Do not reshuffle to inspect more.
mechanics.fit: Plans a counter or defense for already telegraphed enemy attacks.
mechanics.risk: No extra draw or new enemy information; small decks make selection powerful.

mechanics.name: Choose one
mechanics.rule: Choose exactly one printed mode when playing this card. Only that mode resolves.
mechanics.fit: Respond to the enemy intent with one flexible deck slot.
mechanics.risk: Both modes must remain weaker than dedicated cards; cloning never grants both modes.

mechanics.name: Follow-through
mechanics.rule: Gain the bonus if the immediately previous card manually played this turn meets the printed condition. Any other manual main-deck play breaks the sequence.
mechanics.fit: Makes the order of attack and defense matter.
mechanics.risk: Automatic Suspend effects, side cards, pitching, Cycle and temporary tools neither start nor advance a sequence. Bonuses never scale with unlimited card counts.

mechanics.name: Prepared
mechanics.inspiration: Flesh and Blood — Arsenal, adapted through Retain
mechanics.rule: Uses the existing Retain talent and its single card slot. Gain the bonus only if this exact card was retained from your previous turn; playing consumes Prepared.
mechanics.fit: Gives the existing talent situational payoffs without adding a reserve zone.
mechanics.risk: No free Retain, no multi-turn stacking. Clones start unprepared and Suspend is not Retain.

mechanics.name: Reprise
mechanics.rule: On your turn, pay 2 energy to play this from discard once per encounter across all copies of this concept ID, then exhaust it.
mechanics.fit: Reuses a known answer at a premium, at the cost of losing it from rotation.
mechanics.risk: Never retrieve pitched or exhausted cards. Disable if fewer than four non-exhausted, non-pitched main-deck cards would remain. Copies share the once-per-encounter limit.

mechanics.name: Improvise
mechanics.inspiration: Hearthstone — Discover, adapted to a fixed menu
mechanics.rule: Choose one printed temporary tool and add it to hand. Each tool costs 1 energy and vanishes when played, discarded or at encounter end. Source exhausts.
mechanics.fit: A fixed three-option menu supports tactical choice without a random collection-wide pool.
mechanics.risk: Tools cannot be pitched, retained, cloned, suspended, boosted or Reprised. No mastery, Aether, on-play talent or sequence triggers; tools do not count toward the four-card minimum. Respect the existing hand limit.

cards.name: Cinder Capacitor

tiers.rules: Deal 5 damage. Amplify +1 energy: deal 6 additional damage in the same hit.
Deal 7 damage. Amplify +1 energy: deal 7 additional damage in the same hit.
Deal 9 damage. Amplify +1 energy: deal 8 additional damage in the same hit.
Deal 12 damage. Amplify +1 energy: deal 10 additional damage in the same hit.

cards.decision: Spend energy now or bank Aether for utility.
cards.tradeoff: At level 0, two energy gives 11 damage versus Sundering Arc’s 13.

cards.name: Crystal Aegis

tiers.rules: Gain 4 Block. Amplify +1 energy: gain 5 additional Block.
Gain 6 Block. Amplify +1 energy: gain 6 additional Block.
Gain 8 Block. Amplify +1 energy: gain 7 additional Block.
Gain 10 Block. Amplify +1 energy: gain 9 additional Block.

cards.decision: Scale defense to the incoming hit.
cards.tradeoff: At level 0, two energy gives 9 Block versus Winter Bastion’s 11.

cards.name: Shifting Edge

tiers.rules: Deal 5 damage. Cycle 1: instead pay 1 energy, discard this and draw 1.
Deal 7 damage. Cycle 1: instead pay 1 energy, discard this and draw 1.
Deal 9 damage. Cycle 1: instead pay 1 energy, discard this and draw 1.
Deal 12 damage. Cycle 1: instead pay 1 energy, discard this and draw 1.

cards.decision: Use damage or search for an answer.
cards.tradeoff: Damage trails Ember Blade; Cycle costs energy and is capped.

cards.name: Mist Veil

tiers.rules: Gain 4 Block. Cycle 1: instead pay 1 energy, discard this and draw 1.
Gain 6 Block. Cycle 1: instead pay 1 energy, discard this and draw 1.
Gain 8 Block. Cycle 1: instead pay 1 energy, discard this and draw 1.
Gain 10 Block. Cycle 1: instead pay 1 energy, discard this and draw 1.

cards.decision: Trade unused defense for a different card on setup turns.
cards.tradeoff: Cannot create free draw loops or Aether.

cards.name: Star Chart

tiers.rules: Gain 2 Block. Foresee 2.
Gain 3 Block. Foresee 2.
Gain 4 Block. Foresee 2.
Gain 5 Block. Foresee 2.

cards.tradeoff: Less immediate Block than Crystal Ward; does not draw.

cards.name: Horizon Needle

tiers.rules: Deal 3 damage. Foresee 2.
Deal 5 damage. Foresee 2.
Deal 7 damage. Foresee 2.
Deal 9 damage. Foresee 2.

cards.decision: Trade damage now for a better next hand.
cards.tradeoff: Ember Blade deals 6/9/12/16; selection is the compensation.

cards.name: Dusk Protocol

tiers.rules: Choose one: deal 5 damage; or gain 4 Block.
Choose one: deal 7 damage; or gain 6 Block.
Choose one: deal 9 damage; or gain 8 Block.
Choose one: deal 12 damage; or gain 10 Block.

cards.decision: Match the card to the current intent.
cards.tradeoff: Each mode is weaker than a dedicated card.

cards.name: Tidal Decision

tiers.rules: Choose one: gain 7 Block; or draw 1 card. Exhaust.
Choose one: gain 9 Block; or draw 1 card. Exhaust.
Choose one: gain 12 Block; or draw 1 card. Exhaust.
Choose one: gain 15 Block; or draw 1 card. Exhaust.

cards.tradeoff: Exhaust applies to either mode; no repeatable draw engine.

cards.name: Wardbreaker Step

tiers.rules: Deal 4 damage. If the previous manually played main-deck card this turn had kind Defense, deal 4 additional damage in the same hit.
Deal 6 damage. If the previous manually played main-deck card this turn had kind Defense, deal 5 additional damage in the same hit.
Deal 8 damage. If the previous manually played main-deck card this turn had kind Defense, deal 6 additional damage in the same hit.
Deal 10 damage. If the previous manually played main-deck card this turn had kind Defense, deal 8 additional damage in the same hit.

cards.tradeoff: A Skill granting Block does not qualify; payoff is bounded.

cards.name: Afterimage Ward

tiers.rules: Gain 3 Block. If the previous manually played main-deck card this turn had an Attack kind (including elemental and Soulbound Attack), gain 4 additional Block.
Gain 5 Block. If the previous manually played main-deck card this turn had an Attack kind (including elemental and Soulbound Attack), gain 4 additional Block.
Gain 6 Block. If the previous manually played main-deck card this turn had an Attack kind (including elemental and Soulbound Attack), gain 5 additional Block.
Gain 8 Block. If the previous manually played main-deck card this turn had an Attack kind (including elemental and Soulbound Attack), gain 6 additional Block.

cards.decision: Attack first while saving energy to protect yourself.
cards.tradeoff: Automatic effects and side cards cannot enable it.

cards.name: Patient Bastion

tiers.rules: Gain 4 Block. Prepared: gain 4 additional Block if retained from your previous turn.
Gain 6 Block. Prepared: gain 5 additional Block if retained from your previous turn.
Gain 8 Block. Prepared: gain 6 additional Block if retained from your previous turn.
Gain 10 Block. Prepared: gain 8 additional Block if retained from your previous turn.

cards.decision: Save for a visible upcoming heavy attack.
cards.tradeoff: Requires the existing Retain talent and competes for its one slot.

cards.name: Ambush Prism

tiers.rules: Deal 5 damage. Prepared: deal 4 additional damage in the same hit if retained from your previous turn.
Deal 7 damage. Prepared: deal 5 additional damage in the same hit if retained from your previous turn.
Deal 9 damage. Prepared: deal 6 additional damage in the same hit if retained from your previous turn.
Deal 12 damage. Prepared: deal 7 additional damage in the same hit if retained from your previous turn.

cards.decision: Hold through a guard turn, then attack.
cards.tradeoff: Competes with retaining Prismatic Counter; no accumulating bonus.

cards.name: Echo Brand

tiers.rules: Deal 5 damage. Reprise 2: play this from discard for 2 energy once per encounter across all copies, then exhaust it.
Deal 7 damage. Reprise 2: play this from discard for 2 energy once per encounter across all copies, then exhaust it.
Deal 9 damage. Reprise 2: play this from discard for 2 energy once per encounter across all copies, then exhaust it.
Deal 12 damage. Reprise 2: play this from discard for 2 energy once per encounter across all copies, then exhaust it.

cards.decision: Reuse known damage at a premium.
cards.tradeoff: Cannot recur pitched/exhausted cards; leave four other circulating cards.

cards.name: Field Fabricator

tiers.rules: Improvise: choose a temporary 1-energy tool — Bolt (deal 7 damage), Plate (gain 6 Block), or Lens (Foresee 2, then draw 1). Exhaust this source card.
Improvise: choose a temporary 1-energy tool — Bolt (deal 9 damage), Plate (gain 8 Block), or Lens (Foresee 2, then draw 1). Exhaust this source card.
Improvise: choose a temporary 1-energy tool — Bolt (deal 12 damage), Plate (gain 10 Block), or Lens (Foresee 2, then draw 1). Exhaust this source card.
Improvise: choose a temporary 1-energy tool — Bolt (deal 15 damage), Plate (gain 13 Block), or Lens (Foresee 2, then draw 1). Exhaust this source card.
